title: Mock2 build outcome (enumerated) — pending-operator-verification is first-class
description: PATCH2 B.1. The terminal outcomes a build cycle can reach, and the builder's terminal moves that produce them. pending-operator-verification is a first-class RETURNABLE outcome (the builder's `pending_verification` tool), a calm completion — NOT routed through the deviation/blocker queue. It is reachable only when the integration gate passed for real, implemented code.

invariant.const: pending-operator-verification is valid ONLY when the integration gate passed for real, implemented code; a stub / canned success / fabricated-data path can never reach it — it blocks.
